_how: Do exactly ONE open task per run, in order. Mark it done with the date and a one-line note. refresh-oldest repeats forever once the rest are done.

tasks.title: Fix the 3 hidden pre-dated drafts
tasks.detail: socal-rate-watch-september-2026, socal-rate-watch-october-2026 and socal-refinance-guide-2026 were written on 2026-04-30 with future dates and noindex, so the rate watches hold numbers written before those months happened. Rewrite each one with real, sourced Freddie Mac PMMS numbers for that month and honest dates, remove noindex, add them to the insights index and sitemap. If the real numbers cannot be sourced, leave noindex in place and report it (vercel.json is off limits, so no redirects).

tasks.title: Clean the author box on older articles
tasks.detail: Older insights articles say "Bilingual SoCal Realtor" and "Spanish/English" in the author box and image alt. Replace with the template author box line (Realtor, DRE, 100+ closings, 5.0 on Google, cities). Copy rule: never promote bilingual.

tasks.title: Link every article from at least 2 related pages
tasks.detail: Most articles get 0 or 1 inbound links (excluding the insights index). For each, add one natural in-sentence link from 2 relevant pages (a city guide, a related article, /buyer or /seller). Do up to 6 articles per run until none is under 2.

tasks.title: Backfill sitemap lastmod
tasks.detail: Only 13 of 135 sitemap URLs have lastmod. Set lastmod from `git log -1 --format=%cs -- public/<file>` for every URL.
